name: cisco-meraki-mcp
description: Every Meraki Dashboard operation, plus cross-org fleet views, complete pagination, and a local mirror built for MSPs running many client orgs.

meraki_dashboard_api_key.title: MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY
meraki_dashboard_api_key.description: Meraki Dashboard API key (Dashboard > My profile > API access). It can reach every organization the generating admin can see.

cisco_meraki_base_url.title: CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_URL
cisco_meraki_base_url.description: Dashboard API base URL. Leave the default unless your orgs live in a regional dashboard: https://api.meraki.ca/api/v1 (Canada), https://api.meraki.cn/api/v1 (China), https://api.meraki.in/api/v1 (India), https://api.gov-meraki.com/api/v1 (FedRAMP).
